description:
Outcome: Gardener applies for a coming season, from brief.md / First version 1 and Rules.
Scope: One application per household/season with zero to three distinct preferred plots through labelled choices. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Preference bounds enforced; retries cannot duplicate submissions; original server receipt timestamp/sequence immutable; confirmation shows preferences.
Behaviour: Preserve draft on failure; explain absent/closed season; no silent lost submission. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Phone journey and validation, duplicate and concurrent submission tests. Prerequisites: T-002, T-003, T-004. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover.
title: Submit seasonal applications
